_meta.title: Ethiopian startups — gathered research dataset (DRAFT)
_meta.status: UNVERIFIED research draft — review before importing or publishing
_meta.rule: Real, public-sourced entries only. No fabricated funding or valuation numbers. Each record carries sources + a confidence level. Run through docs/data-verification.md (corroborate + human sign-off) before anything goes live.
_meta.schemaNote: Fields mirror models/start-up.ts for easy import (name, website, sector, location, foundedYear, stage, description). Funding lives under `_funding` (not in the current schema) and is included ONLY when sourced. `_meta.confidence` is high | medium | low; `_meta.sources` lists where it came from. This file is not wired into the app.
_meta.note: Some entries likely already exist in the live DB (e.g. Chapa, Arifpay, Dodai, Kifiya, Kubik) — dedupe on import. Several current seed rows (e.g. 'Better Auth', 'EduTech Ethiopia', 'HealthLink Ethiopia', 'LogiSmart Ethiopia') appear to be placeholders and could be replaced by these real ones.
